svg.text: 10' ceiling • single blue roll-up door (in + out) • floor-stacked crates, no racking • notch confirmed NOT present on site (removed from this drawing)
Path runs in the 3 aisles only, never across a crate row • Teal = Bakery leg (Aisle A → B, K1/K2/K3) • Dark = Meals leg (Aisle B → C, M1/M2/M3) • cart exits the same door
